描述_EN: many mirrors are decorated with mystical scenes of daoism. this mirror shows the mythical journey of the 8th-century emperor ming huang to the palace of the moon goddess. mirrors in china were associated with daoist mysticism as well as being a functional object in the house.
描述_ZN: 许多镜子上都装饰着道教的神秘场景。 这面镜子展示了8世纪的明皇到月神宫的神话之旅。 中国的镜子与道家的神秘主义有关，同时也是家里的一个实用物品。
